answer: An EV certificate makes each extra identity pay $119 a year for a Sectigo check of one registered legal entity; a farm running N fakes pays N×$119 and cannot share it because one certificate names exactly one company. The registry reads each cert from the canyon of the public transparency log, where a yarrow of fresh serial numbers keeps copies visible and quartz clocks stamp each renewal. A farm reusing one company dies by transparency-log dedup at 2: the second cert for one entity flags both and burns both seats.
